title: Monitoring in production: performance, latency and cost

videos.script: The service from lesson 8 is running. Is it working? {{running}} That question is four questions, and they are answered at very different speeds. Is it answering, and how fast: you know within seconds. {{fast}} What is it saying: you know by tomorrow morning, if you compare tonight with the nights before. {{saying}} Was it right: you know in ninety days, when the members have either come back or not. {{right}} This lesson builds a check for each. A log line for every request, and a load test that shows the average hiding the slow ones. {{log}} A watch that compares tonight's scores and inputs with the four weeks before, and catches a broken load that every other step reported as a success. {{watch}} A report card that grades a night's scores once the outcomes are in. {{card}} And what each way of serving costs to keep running, which is mostly not money. {{cost}}
